test_title: PYST 206: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 24th Nov, 2021 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'LEJ' is written as 'XJT' and 'FAME' is written as 'LBZJ'. How will 'CABLE' be written in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/abdd61d4ceead7fb3fe65b197354f6b957d4797aacc8f4e664a629c05966638a.png] 

'LEJ' is written as 'XJT'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/717e507ba5412420b2e790f80001ff5612b50c194cab0da729dbd518de204d10.png] 

and

'FAME' is written as 'LBZJ'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0f0b51aaaa45ae7dd7eccf73af86acb566977d36e1f33678dce9868032b8913.png] 

Similarly,

'CABLE' will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f9f26ce8b6dc15f49729ca78b34b1a10f0d888c02c10a4f79054dd2bcf7b819.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"FBDXJ".**
